Sandbox_daysPerYear_tooltip: Number of in-game survival days that count as one year of character age.
Sandbox_declineAge_tooltip: At this age and older, additional fitness and strength XP decline is applied once per in-game day.
Sandbox_physicalDecline: Additional daily fitness and strength XP loss (%)
Sandbox_physicalDecline_tooltip: Percentage of each skill's current total XP lost per in-game day at or above the decline age.
Sandbox_isDeathEnabled_tooltip: Each in-game day the mod checks whether that is the day you die or not.
Sandbox_isTraitsConsidered_tooltip: Physical and health traits can lower or raise mortality risk.
Sandbox_deathAge: Minimum age for death by old age
Sandbox_isGrayHairEnabled_tooltip: At or above the gray hair age, the current hair and beard colors are overwritten with gray.
Sandbox_isShortSightedEnabled_tooltip: Adds Short Sighted at or above the configured age unless the character has Eagle Eyed.
Sandbox_isHardOfHearingEnabled_tooltip: Adds Hard of Hearing at or above the configured age unless the character has Keen Hearing or Deaf.
